lines.en: label beachmas17:
scene beachmassanta1
: Alright, everybody! Now that Ayane has returned without Uta and Io, it means it’s safe to assume that they drowned and that it’s okay to start Secret Santa without them!
lines.zh: : 好了各位！既然 Ayane 一个人回来了、Uta 和 Io 没跟回来，那我们大可放心地认定她们淹死了，不等她俩就开始 Secret Santa 也没问题啦！

lines.en: : They didn’t {i}drown.{/i} I found them and they’ll be here soon. I’m pretty sure Uta just needs a minute to collect herself for...reasons beyond my comprehension at the current moment.
lines.zh: : 她们没{i}淹死{/i}。我找到她们了，很快就过来。我敢肯定 Uta 只是需要点时间缓一缓，至于原因……我目前还理解不了。

lines.en: : Okay! Nevermind! Guess we can all sit here and fuck ourselves while we wait! In a nonliteral way, of course, so Kirin and Nodoka don’t combine brains and have a collective aneurysm!
lines.zh: : 好嘞！当我没说！看来我们都得坐在这儿干等着，自己解决自己了！当然是非字面意义上的，免得 Kirin 和 Nodoka 两台脑子合体，集体脑溢血！

lines.en: : Just implanting the thought in my head is enough to get me through the night.
lines.zh: : 光是把这个念头塞进我脑子里，就够我撑过今晚了。

lines.en: : Sure, Kirin. As if it wasn’t already there.
lines.zh: : 是吗，Kirin。好像这念头本来不在那儿似的。

lines.en: : Hey! Here’s a fun idea! How about, instead of oversharing the things that turn us on, we share our favorite Christmas memories! Starting with Ami!
lines.zh: : 嘿！我有个好主意！与其互相爆料自己被什么撩到，不如来聊聊我们最喜欢的圣诞回忆吧！从 Ami 开始！

lines.en: : Sure! I think my favorite Christmas memory is from when I was still a little girl and-
lines.zh: : 好呀！我最喜欢的圣诞回忆，是我还是个小女孩的时候，然后——

lines.en: scene beachmassanta2
: Oh, look! Dorm 7 is back! Which means that we can all stop listening to Ami’s story and start giving each other shit! And I won’t even have to worry about being snubbed this year!
lines.zh: : 哦，快看！七号宿舍的人回来了！这意味着我们终于不用再听 Ami 讲故事，可以开始互相挖苦了！而且今年我都不用担心被人冷落了！

lines.en: : Feeling any better, Uta?
lines.zh: : 好点了吗，Uta？

lines.en: : This dream sure is carrying on for a long time.
lines.zh: : 这场梦还真是拖得够久的。

lines.en: scene black
scene beachmassanta3
: Merry Christmas, Yasu. I bestow unto you another MacCormack creation — your very own staff to complete your favorite costume in the club room.
lines.zh: : 圣诞快乐，Yasu。我再赐予你一件 MacCormack 出品——属于你自己的法杖，正好配齐你在社团教室里那套最喜欢的服装。

lines.en: : The quality isn’t as good as mine, but I still managed to channel enough of my energy into it to allow the orb to float. Just don’t poke it or it may explode and kill you.
lines.zh: : 品质比不上我那根，但我还是往里面注入了足够的能量，能让那颗宝珠浮起来。别拿东西戳它，不然它可能会爆炸把你炸死。

lines.en: : Am I really allowed to have this?
lines.zh: : 我真的可以收下这个吗？

lines.en: : Of course! Tis’ the season, after all.
lines.zh: : 当然！毕竟是过节嘛。

lines.en: : I mean religiously. Magic goes against the tenets of my beliefs and even holding such an object puts me at risk of disintegration.
lines.zh: : 我是说在宗教意义上。魔法违背我的信仰信条，光是拿着这种东西，就让我有灰飞烟灭的风险。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta4
: Tsk tsk tsk. There is no {i}real{/i} magic imbued in this staff, Yasu. The {i}real{/i} magic is the friends we made along the way.
lines.zh: : 啧啧啧。这根法杖里可没有{i}真正{/i}的魔法，Yasu。{i}真正{/i}的魔法，是我们一路上交到的朋友。

lines.en: : That sounds even more dangerous...
lines.zh: : 听起来更危险了……

lines.en: : And it very well may be. But if you continue following in my footsteps, I can guarantee you that you’ll never have enough friends to make it a problem.
lines.zh: : 很可能确实如此。不过你要是继续沿着我的脚步走下去，我敢保证你永远交不到足够多的朋友，也就构不成问题了。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta5
: Merry holiday, Touka. May your days be joyous and filled with your preferred consistency of egg yolk.
lines.zh: : 节日快乐，Touka。愿你的日子充满喜悦，蛋黄也永远是你喜欢的那个稠度。

lines.en: : Thank you, Tsuneyo. Merry egg yolk to you as well and best wishes to you and your father.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Tsuneyo。也祝你蛋黄快乐，并祝你和你父亲一切安好。

lines.en: : You appear troubled. Would you like to share some of the best Christmas present I have ever received? Out of the three Christmas presents I have ever received.
lines.zh: : 你看起来有心事。要不要分一点我收到过的最棒的圣诞礼物？在我这辈子收到过的三份圣诞礼物里最棒的那份。

lines.en: : No thank you. I have trouble eating when I’m nervous and I worry that I’m about to once again ruin Christmas.
lines.zh: : 不了，谢谢。我一紧张就吃不下东西，而且我担心自己又要再一次把圣诞节搞砸了。

lines.en: : If you are going to murder someone, I believe Io would be the best choice. She contributes nothing to the class and would only be missed by one person.
lines.zh: : 如果你打算杀人的话，我觉得 Io 是最佳选择。她对班级毫无贡献，也只会有一个人想念她。

lines.en: : But no matter who you decide to kill, please spare my son. I am willing to die in his place. But only if you can defeat me in hand to hand combat.
lines.zh: : 但不管你决定杀谁，请放过我儿子。我愿意替他去死。但前提是你得在徒手格斗中打赢我。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta6
: I have no intention of killing anyone. I just have a proven track record of giving gifts that are considered {i}over-excessive{/i} by my classmates.
lines.zh: : 我没打算杀任何人。我只是有过前科——送的礼物会被同学们认为{i}过于夸张{/i}。

lines.en: : And yes, that record may be comprised of just one thing, but that does nothing to dispel my worries and Sensei is {i}already{/i} difficult to shop for when his interests are limited to just...women.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那前科也许只由一件事构成，但这丝毫不能打消我的顾虑，而且老师{i}本来{/i}就难买礼物，因为他的兴趣仅限于……女人。

lines.en: : Sir appears to like the shirt I made for him. He’s been regularly wearing it for a whole year now.
lines.zh: : 先生似乎很喜欢我给他做的那件衬衫。整整一年了，他都一直穿着。

lines.en: : I’m sure that whatever you got for our teacher will be great, Touka. You’re so kind and smart and good and have so much money to spend on material goods.
lines.zh: : 我相信你给我们老师准备的东西一定很棒，Touka。你那么善良、聪明、人品好，还有大把大把的钱可以花在物质上。

lines.en: : What’d you get him anyway? I don’t remember you bringing anything with you on the bus ride over. Well, apart from your seemingly infinite inventory of cosmetic equipment.
lines.zh: : 你到底给他买了什么？我不记得你来的时候在巴士上带了什么东西啊。除了你那看似无穷无尽的化妆装备库存。

lines.en: : You can never have too many breast-accentuating tops. Isn’t that right, noodle-refuser?
lines.zh: : 凸显胸部的上衣永远不嫌多。对吧，拒绝吃面那位？

lines.en: : You could always give the Herald a wardrobe malfunction for Christmas. I’m sure that would go over well.
lines.zh: : 你也可以送先驱者一个圣诞走光当礼物嘛。我敢说反响一定很好。

lines.en: : Perhaps {i}too{/i} well...
lines.zh: : 也许{i}好过头{/i}了……

lines.en: : Unfortunately, I agreed earlier to not reveal the true nature of my gift to anyone else, so...
lines.zh: : 可惜我之前答应过，不会把礼物的真实性质透露给任何人，所以……

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll just have to wait and see what {i}his{/i} reaction to it will be...
lines.zh: : 那我就只能等着看{i}他{/i}的反应了……

lines.en: scene beachmassanta7
: Umm...yes, Ami?
lines.zh: : 呃……怎么了，Ami？

lines.en: : Oh, don’t mind me. I’m just waiting for my present.
lines.zh: : 哦，别管我。我只是在等我的礼物。

lines.en: : And...what makes you think I’m the one who has it?
lines.zh: : 还有……你凭什么觉得礼物在我这儿？

lines.en: : I saw my name on the slip of paper you drew from the hat.
lines.zh: : 我看见你从帽子里抽出来的那张纸条上写着我的名字。

lines.en: : Right, right...
: And on the off chance I left your present at home?
lines.zh: : 万一我把你的礼物落在家里了呢？

lines.en: scene beachmassanta8
: You what?! How?! You’re normally so prepared for this kinda thing! Do I really mean so little to you that you couldn’t even remember me on this super special, super important day?!
lines.zh: : 你说什么？！怎么会？！这种事你一向准备得妥妥当当的啊！在你心里我就这么无足轻重，连在这个超级特别、超级重要的日子里都记不起我吗？！

lines.en: : I’ll make it up to you okay?! This whole trip kind of, like...came out of nowhere for me. So...
lines.zh: : 我会补偿你的好吗？！这趟旅行真的……来得太突然了。所以……

lines.en: : We went shopping together for the trip like four days ago! Stop making excuses and tell me what my present is!
lines.zh: : 我们四天前才一起为这趟旅行采购过！别找借口了，快说我的礼物是什么！

lines.en: : On the bright side, you’re not the only person without a present. Seems like a few people forgot to bring things this year. Myself included.
lines.zh: : 往好处想，你不是唯一一个没礼物的人。看来今年有好几个人忘带东西了。包括我。

lines.en: : In fact, {i}none{/i} of us have gotten presents yet.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我们到现在还{i}一个人都没{/i}收到礼物呢。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta9
: Hi. Melon delivery. Where do you want it?
lines.zh: : 嗨。蜜瓜快递。放哪儿？

lines.en: : Anywhere is fine since Karin didn’t come this year. And thank you very much for such a thoughtful gift, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 哪儿都行，反正 Karin 今年没来。还有，Makoto，非常谢谢你这份用心挑选的礼物。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta10
: Oooh, she got me one of the cube ones. Well done.
lines.zh: : 哦哦，她给我的是方块形的那种。干得漂亮。

lines.en: : What were you saying about none of us getting presents, Maya?
lines.zh: : 你刚才说我们都没收到礼物，是什么意思，Maya？

lines.en: scene beachmassanta11
: Just that Ayane’s not the only person who forgot to bring hers and that I, too, am a horrible friend.
lines.zh: : 只是说 Ayane 不是唯一一个忘带礼物的人，而我也是个糟糕透顶的朋友。

lines.en: : Unless I was assigned someone I’m not friends with. In that case, I’d just be a bad person.
lines.zh: : 除非我抽到的是个跟我不是朋友的人。那样的话，我就只是个坏人而已。

lines.en: : How do you not even remember who you got? You had two whole months to plan this.
lines.zh: : 你怎么连自己抽到谁都记不住？你有整整两个月的时间来准备啊。

lines.en: : I’ll find out sooner or later. Just keep an eye out for anyone else walking around empty handed.
lines.zh: : 我迟早会知道的。你就留意一下还有谁在空着手瞎逛吧。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta12
: Like Sensei over there- who looks like he’s about to be ritualistically whisked away by yet another troubled partygoer.
lines.zh: : 比如那边的老师——他看起来马上又要被另一个问题少女以仪式般的方式掳走了。

lines.en: : He forgot to get somebody a present too, didn’t he?
lines.zh: : 他也忘了给谁准备礼物了吧？

lines.en: : Looks that way.
lines.zh: : 看起来是。

lines.en: : Why am I the only one in this dysfunctional family who cares about Christmas this year?
lines.zh: : 为什么今年这个病态大家庭里，就我一个人把圣诞节当回事啊？

lines.en: scene black
scene beachmassanta13
: Hey! How busy are you on a scale of one to ten?
lines.zh: : 嘿！你现在的忙碌程度，一到十打几分？

lines.en: : Like a four. It feels like I’ve barely even been the protagonist for the last couple days.
lines.zh: : 大概四分吧。感觉这两天我都没怎么当上主角。

lines.en: : Great! That means you can come with me to see the super awesome present I got you!
lines.zh: : 太好了！那你可以跟我来，看看我给你准备的超级棒的礼物！

lines.en: scene beachmassanta14
: Also, do you know where Rin is? I haven’t seen her since Niki’s concert ended.
lines.zh: : 另外，你知道 Rin 在哪儿吗？Niki 的演唱会结束之后我就没见过她了。

lines.en: : She wasn’t feeling well and is laying down in my room for now. She’ll probably come back once she remembers there is life outside of Otoha.
lines.zh: : 她不太舒服，现在躺在我房间里休息。等她想起来 Otoha 之外还有别的生活，大概就会回来了。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta15
: I am lowkey fed up with Otoha. She has no idea what she’s missing.
lines.zh: : 我有点受够 Otoha 了。她根本不知道自己错过了什么。

lines.en: : Says a girl who willingly missed out on the same exact thing.
lines.zh: : 这话从一个自愿错过了同样东西的女孩嘴里说出来，可真有说服力。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta16
: The heart wants what the heart wants. And sometimes the heart wants a six foot tall adult male with a big dick. You got a problem?
lines.zh: : 心想要什么，心就要什么。有时候心想要的是一个六英尺高的成年男性，还长着一根大鸡巴。你有意见？

lines.en: : Not really. If anything, I’m more curious about what’s going on behind you right now.
lines.zh: : 也没什么意见。倒不如说，我现在更好奇你身后正在发生什么。

lines.en: : Is that code for something? Because I’m down if you are.
lines.zh: : 这是暗号吗？你要是有兴趣，我也奉陪。

lines.en: : It wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : Well, it should be. Niki always gets my heart pounding and I’d let you do pretty much anything you want to me right now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，应该是才对。Niki 总让我心跳加速，现在你对我做什么我都愿意。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta17
: Wait, no. Shit. Not right now. I completely lost myself for a second and forgot I needed you to follow me.
lines.zh: : 等等，不对。操。不是现在。我刚才有一瞬间彻底失神了，忘了我还得让你跟过来。

lines.en: : Can that wait a second? Because I kind of want to hear more about your fantasies involving a certain pink-haired-
lines.zh: : 能等一下吗？因为我还挺想多听听你关于某个粉毛的幻想——

lines.en: scene beachmassanta18
: Maybe another time. We’ve got more important stuff to do right now.
lines.zh: : 改天吧。我们现在有更重要的事要做。

lines.en: scene black
scene beachmassanta19
: So...what exactly did you get for me that has an apparently strict time limit and {i}isn’t{/i} sex?
lines.zh: : 那么……你到底给我准备了什么，居然还有严格的时间限制，而且{i}不是{/i}性？

lines.en: : Only the greatest present in the whole wide world.
lines.zh: : 无非是全世界最棒的礼物。

lines.en: : Got it. So it {i}is{/i} sex.
lines.zh: : 懂了。那{i}就是{/i}性。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta20
: That would certainly be an interesting turn of events. But no, it’s not that.
lines.zh: : 那倒确实是挺有意思的展开。但不是，不是那个。

lines.en: : In fact, it’s not really as much of a present as it is a surprise.
lines.zh: : 事实上，它与其说是礼物，不如说是个惊喜。

lines.en: : My {i}real{/i} present is still on the way. It just needs a little more...preparation first.
lines.zh: : 我{i}真正{/i}的礼物还在路上。它只是需要再多一点……准备。

lines.en: : I don’t think non-present surprises are a valid Secret Santa gift.
lines.zh: : 我觉得非礼物的惊喜不能算作有效的 Secret Santa 礼物。

lines.en: : I didn’t have you for Secret Santa this year.
lines.zh: : 今年的 Secret Santa 我抽到的不是你。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta21
: You didn’t?
lines.zh: : 不是我？

lines.en: : No. This is just a thing I’m getting you involved with because of how much I love you. Which is a lot. And it’s okay if I say that since nobody else can hear us right now.
lines.zh: : 不是。这只是因为我太爱你了，才把你卷进来的事。是真的很爱。反正现在没别人能听见，说说也无妨。

lines.en: : Correct. But this also means that there is another present waiting for me back in that room and you are keeping me from it.
lines.zh: : 没错。但这同时也意味着，那间屋里还有另一份礼物在等我，而你现在正把我从它身边拉开。

lines.en: : Get it later. This is more important.
lines.zh: : 回头再拿。这个更重要。

lines.en: : What can be more important than a mystery gift from a mystery person? That’s two whole layers of mystery.
lines.zh: : 还有什么能比一个神秘人送的神秘礼物更重要？那可是整整两层神秘。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta22
: That.
lines.zh: : 那个。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta23
: Kay! My job is done here. Play nice, you two. I have to go give Miku a box of old accessories and convince her to go fulltime gyaru with me.
lines.zh: : 好嘞！我的活儿干完了。你俩好好相处。我得去给 Miku 送一盒子旧饰品，再说服她跟我一起当全职辣妹。

lines.en: : Thanks, Chika.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Chika。

lines.en: : Mhm! Love ya! Byeeee!
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯！爱你！拜拜——！

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I understand what’s going on right now...
lines.zh: : 我不太确定我现在搞懂了什么……

lines.en: : Make that two of us.
lines.zh: : 再加我一个。

lines.en: : Did you...ask for Chika to bring me to you? Because I’ve been looking all over-
lines.zh: : 你……是让 Chika 带你来见我的吗？因为我一直在到处找——

lines.en: : Why? So you could shout out a bunch of shit about jerking off to me again?
lines.zh: : 找什么？好再冲我喊一堆关于对着我打飞机的屁话？

lines.en: : You gonna be able to keep that to yourself this time? Or should I just walk away now?
lines.zh: : 这次你能管住嘴吗？还是我现在就走？

lines.en: : I can try, yeah.
lines.zh: : 我可以试试，嗯。

lines.en: : Good. Because I still ain’t said all I need to say to you and I’m tryin’ not to let petty shit like what people think about me drag me down anymore. You included.
lines.zh: : 最好能。因为我还有话没跟你说完，而且我正努力不让别人怎么看我这种破事再拖我后腿了。你也包括在内。

lines.en: : And I don’t want a fuckin’ apology either. Wouldn’t mean shit coming from you anyway.
lines.zh: : 而且我也不要你他妈的道歉。反正从你嘴里说出来也没意义。

lines.en: : Luckily for you, I wasn’t about to apologize. Because, like you said, it would mean nothing coming from me.
lines.zh: : 算你走运，我本来也不打算道歉。因为就像你说的，从我嘴里说出来毫无意义。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta24

: We gonna stand here like fuckin’ lunatics or are we gonna sit down? Can’t imagine this shit will be over quick. And if I don’t give my legs a break, I might not be able to book it again when you get all fuckin’ weird.
lines.zh: : 我们是打算跟两个疯子似的站在这儿，还是坐下说？我猜这事儿一时半会儿完不了。而且我要是不让腿歇会儿，等你又开始发神经，我可能就跑不掉了。

lines.en: scene black
Yumi takes a seat at the edge of the pier.
lines.zh: Yumi 在码头边缘坐了下来。

lines.en: I watch as the moon-touched water ripples in the breeze, far warmer than it should ever be this time of year.
lines.zh: 我望着被月光触碰的水面在微风中泛起涟漪，比这个时节该有的温度要暖得多。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta25
And then I set my sights on the face of a girl watching the same exact thing.
lines.zh: 然后，我的目光落在了另一个女孩的脸上——她也在望着一模一样的东西。

lines.en: A girl that, for the first time in what I can safely call {i}years{/i} at this point, found {i}me{/i} instead of me finding her.
lines.zh: 一个女孩。这么{i}多年{/i}了，我大概可以这么说——这是第一次，是她找到了{i}我{/i}，而不是我找到了她。

lines.en: Not counting of course our final moments at the Dorm Wars, which may or may not have even happened at this point.
lines.zh: : 当然，我们在 Dorm Wars 最后的那段时刻不算——那些事现在到底有没有发生过还两说。

lines.en: In fact, it’s hard to recall {i}anything{/i} that’s happened at this point when my relationship with Yumi is arguably one of the most convoluted ones I have...and it’s all for reasons I don’t understand.
lines.zh: 事实上，此刻我几乎回想不起{i}任何{/i}事情，而我和 Yumi 的关系大概算是我所有关系里最错综复杂的一段了……而且全都是些我不明白的原因。

lines.en: She’s never made it to the rooftop. She’s never even entered my house.
lines.zh: 她从没上过天台。她甚至从没进过我家。

lines.en: And her feelings, though blurred by my serpent tongue and its tendency to graze the skin of my unsuspecting prey, are all skin deep.
lines.zh: 而她的感情，虽然被我蛇一般的舌头、以及它爱掠过毫无防备的猎物皮肤的习惯弄得模糊不清，却全都只停留在皮肤表层。

lines.en: I’m certain I could taste them if I sunk my fangs into her again.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，如果我的獠牙再次咬进她，就能尝到它们的味道。

lines.en: If I coiled around her body...waited patiently for her to stop moving...
lines.zh: 如果我盘绕住她的身体……耐心地等她停止挣扎……

lines.en: {b}DEVOURED HER WHOLE{/b}
lines.zh: {b}将她整个吞下{/b}

lines.en: But I will not.
lines.zh: 但我不会。

lines.en: Because her flesh looks better in the moonlight.
lines.zh: 因为她的肌肤在月光下更好看。

lines.en: And I long for the added effect of how my bedroom window will make it glow someday.
lines.zh: 而且我渴望有一天，我卧室的窗子会让它的光泽更加动人。

lines.en: Maybe far off in the future.
lines.zh: 也许在很远的未来。

lines.en: Or maybe tonight if I have never understood her at all.
lines.zh: 也许就在今晚——如果我从来就没懂过她的话。

lines.en: : What do you think about me?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我这个人怎么样？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？

lines.en: : Just...me as a whole.
lines.zh: : 就是……我整个人。

lines.en: : What kind of person am I? How do you feel when you’re with me?
lines.zh: : 我是哪种人？你跟我在一起时是什么感觉？

lines.en: : Do you ever find yourself getting mad? Confused? And how does that compare to the way you feel about everyone else?
lines.zh: : 你有没有过生气的时候？困惑的时候？跟你对其他所有人的感觉比起来呢？

lines.en: : I don’t...really get why you’re asking.
lines.zh: : 我……真不明白你为什么问这些。

lines.en: : Because I want to fucking know and I just don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 因为我他妈就想知道，可我就是搞不懂。

lines.en: : You’re a confusing dude. And you do tons of shit that makes me want to rip your guts out and stomp on ‘em...but you’ve also helped me a lot. And I can’t ignore that shit anymore.
lines.zh: : 你是个让人摸不透的家伙。你干的那些破事，有一堆都让我想把你的肠子掏出来踩烂……可你也帮了我很多。我再也没法无视这一点了。

lines.en: : Not if it’s gonna make me feel like this.
lines.zh: : 只要它还让我有这种感觉，就没法无视。

lines.en: : Like {i}what,{/i} Yumi?
lines.zh: : 哪种{i}感觉{/i}，Yumi？

lines.en: scene beachmassanta26

: Like...calling you out here in the middle of the night just so I can talk to you. That ain’t shit I {i}want{/i} to do...but it’s shit I feel like I {i}have{/i} to do and I don’t get why I suddenly feel like that.
lines.zh: : 比如……大半夜把你叫出来，就为了跟你说说话。这种事我才{i}不想{/i}干……可我偏偏觉得{i}非干不可{/i}，我也不明白自己怎么突然就变成这样了。

lines.en: : I did a lot of thinking in my time away from school...mostly about how I wished I would’ve fucked Nodoka up even harder, but I thought a lot about {i}you{/i} too.
lines.zh: : 我离开学校的那段时间想了很多……大部分是后悔当初没把 Nodoka 揍得更狠，但我也想了很多关于{i}你{/i}的事。

lines.en: : But before you go freakin’ out again about how horrible of a douche we all know you are, there were some actual, like...{i}good{/i} thoughts in there.
lines.zh: : 不过你先别急着又开始犯病，说什么你这个人有多混蛋——那堆想法里确实有些，怎么说呢……{i}好的{/i}念头。

lines.en: : Maybe it’s just cause I’m so used to all of the adults in my life being fuckin’ worthless criminals...but you ain’t been all that bad by comparison.
lines.zh: : 也许只是因为我生命里那些成年人全他妈都是没用的罪犯……但相比之下，你还不算太糟。

lines.en: : Done more for me than my mom or dad ever did, that’s for sure.
lines.zh: : 起码比我妈我爸为我做的多多了，这是肯定的。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta27
: That said, though...you’re still fucking scum. And the chances of you ever bein’ able to redeem yourself for all of the horrible shit you’ve done don’t even exist as far as I’m concerned.
lines.zh: : 话虽这么说……你还是个彻头彻尾的人渣。而且在我看来，你想为自己干过的那些烂事赎罪，几率根本等于零。

lines.en: : It ain’t just me you’re lettin’ down by bein’ so caught up in yourself that you can’t see everybody else, it’s...well, {i}everybody else{/i} that’s bein’ let down. You get it?
lines.zh: : 你陷在自己里头，看不见其他所有人，你辜负的不只是我，而是……好吧，是{i}所有其他人{/i}。你明白吗？

lines.en: : I do...but I don’t think you would have had Chika bring me here if that’s all you wanted to say.
lines.zh: : 我明白……但我不觉得，如果你只想说这些，你会让 Chika 把我带到这儿来。

lines.en: : So what else is there? Do you want to make up? Or is this your way of telling me to leave you alone for the rest of forever- a thing we both know I wouldn’t be able to do?
lines.zh: : 那还有什么？你想和好吗？还是说，这是你在告诉我，让我永远离你远点——而这事我们俩都清楚，我做不到？

lines.en: scene beachmassanta28

: I don’t fuckin’ know, man. I’ve been thinkin’ nonstop about all of the shit I was gonna say over the last 24 hours, and now that you’re here, all I wanna do is call you a jack-off and tell you to eat shit.
lines.zh: : 我他妈不知道，老兄。过去这二十四个小时里，我不停地在想自己要说些什么，可现在你人在这儿了，我只想骂你一句傻屌，让你去吃屎。

lines.en: : Why’d you have to go and say all that stuff about yourself, man? Are you {i}trying{/i} to confuse me? Because it fuckin’ worked if that’s what you were going for.
lines.zh: : 你干嘛非得说那些关于你自己的话啊，老兄？你是{i}故意{/i}要搅乱我吗？如果你是这么打算的，那你他妈成功了。

lines.en: : I just want to be honest with you. And that’s a pretty big deal since I can’t even be honest with myself most of the time.
lines.zh: : 我只是想对你诚实。这可是件大事，因为我大部分时候连对自己都诚实不起来。

lines.en: : Honesty fucking hurts. Why couldn’t you just keep lyin’ to me and save me from actually havin’ to use my shitty ass brain? None of this makes sense.
lines.zh: : 诚实真他妈疼。你就不能继续对我撒谎，好让我不用动我那个破脑子吗？这一切都讲不通。

lines.en: : Whether it be your relationship with Chika...
lines.zh: : 不管是你和 Chika 的关系……

lines.en: scene beachmassanta29
: Or how you waited until I was at my most vulnerable to straight up give up on me...
lines.zh: : 还是说，你一直等到我最脆弱的时候，干脆利落地放弃了我……

lines.en: : I know I freaked out when you walked in, but...
lines.zh: : 我知道你走进来的时候我崩溃了，但是……

lines.en: : But there was a serious moment before Nodoka showed up where I felt like I’d actually been {i}saved...{/i}
lines.zh: : 但在 Nodoka 出现之前，有那么一个认真的瞬间，我真的觉得自己{i}得救了{/i}……

lines.en: : But then...
lines.zh: : 可是然后……

lines.en: : You didn’t do shit.
lines.zh: : 你什么都没做。

lines.en: : You just watched it all happen.
lines.zh: : 你就那么眼睁睁看着一切发生。

lines.en: if nodokaspecial15p3 == True:
: You let her blackmail me...
lines.zh: : 你让她敲诈我……

lines.en: : You let me...{i}humiliate{/i} myself in front of you...
lines.zh: : 你让我……在你面前{i}丢尽了脸{/i}……

lines.en: : You let her...you let her take your...fucking {i}pants{/i} off...
lines.zh: : 你让她……你让她把你的……他妈的{i}裤子{/i}脱了……

lines.en: : {i}Touch{/i} you...
: The...the shit I watched you do with Nodoka while you just...just fucking stood there...it {i}haunts{/i} me.
lines.zh: : 我看着你跟 Nodoka 做的那些……他妈的事，而你就……就那么站在那儿……那画面{i}缠着我不放{/i}。

lines.en: : The...fucking {i}noises...{/i}
lines.zh: : 那些……他妈的{i}声音{/i}……

lines.en: : The shit she was saying to me...to {i}you...{/i}
lines.zh: : 她对我说的……对{i}你{/i}说的那些话……

lines.en: : The way your stupid fucking eyes looked for the three seconds I was actually able to look at them...
lines.zh: : 我真正看得清你那双蠢眼的、那三秒钟里，它们是什么样子……

lines.en: : Do you {i}want{/i} me to hurt? Are you punishing me for something?
lines.zh: : 你是{i}想{/i}让我痛苦吗？你在为了什么惩罚我吗？

lines.en: : Why does that make you h-
lines.zh: : 为什么那样能让你——

lines.en: : {b}IMAGINE WHAT IT WOULD BE LIKE FINALLY BEING HELPED BY SOMEONE AFTER YEARS AND YEARS OF DOING EVERYTHING ALONE!{/b}

lines.zh: : {b}我他妈恨你！可我又不恨！行了吗？！我不恨！{/b}

lines.en: scene beachmassanta31
: Or at least I {i}didn’t.{/i}
lines.zh: : 至少以前{i}不恨{/i}。

lines.en: : I don’t know anymore.
lines.zh: : 现在我不知道了。

lines.en: : But at the end of the day, I’m just another stupid fucking girl who can’t figure shit out on her own.
lines.zh: : 但说到底，我也只是又一个自己搞不明白任何事的蠢丫头。

lines.en: : And that’s the exact reason you ever wanted to spend time with me in the first place.
lines.zh: : 而这正是你最初愿意花时间陪我的原因。

lines.en: : Does it make you feel strong, Sensei? Having so much power and never actually using it for anyone but yourself?
lines.zh: : 这让你觉得很有力量吗，老师？手里握着这么大的权力，却从来只为自己使用？

lines.en: : How do you sleep at night?
lines.zh: : 你晚上怎么睡得着觉？

lines.en: : Feel better now?
lines.zh: : 现在好受点了？

lines.en: : A little.
lines.zh: : 好一点了。

lines.en: : Good. Guess I’ll just pick up where we left off a couple months ago then.
lines.zh: : 好。那我就接着几个月前停下的地方说吧。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta32
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I’m exactly the type of person you said I am.
lines.zh: : 我就是你说的那种人。

lines.en: : You were vulnerable, so I swooped in...and did things to make you trust me because I thought it would increase the chances of me getting into your pants one day.
lines.zh: : 你很脆弱，所以我趁虚而入……做了些让你信任我的事，因为我觉得那样能提高有朝一日脱掉你裤子的概率。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta33
: You’re fucking-
lines.zh: : 你他妈——

lines.en: : But that was just the beginning.
lines.zh: : 但那只是开始。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta34
: Somewhere down the line, I actually {i}did{/i} start wanting to help you.
lines.zh: : 不知从什么时候起，我是真的{i}开始{/i}想帮你了。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I just felt indebted because of the horrible experience I put you through in the second half of town so long ago...but I really did want to help.
lines.zh: : 我不知道是不是因为很久以前在后半区让你经历了那么可怕的事，让我觉得亏欠……但我真的想帮你。

lines.en: : And I {i}still{/i} want to help.
lines.zh: : 而且我现在{i}还{/i}想帮你。

lines.en: : But those other feelings? The ones that I know are wrong- that you {i}despise{/i} me for having.
lines.zh: : 可那些别的感情呢？那些我知道是错的、你因此{i}厌恶{/i}我的感情。

lines.en: : I can’t make them go away.
lines.zh: : 我没法让它们消失。

lines.en: : If it was that easy, I’d do it.
lines.zh: : 要是那么容易，我早就做了。

lines.en: : But to me, you...and everyone else...will always find your way into my fan-
lines.zh: : 但对我来说，你……还有其他所有人……总会找到路进入我的幻——

lines.en: scene beachmassanta35
: Don’t tell me about your fucking fantasies! They only make shit more confusing!
lines.zh: : 别跟我讲你那些该死的幻想！它们只会让事情更乱！

lines.en: : I tried to get it all off my chest two months ago, but-
lines.zh: : 两个月前我就试着把这些全倒出来了，可——

lines.en: : And what the fuck are you talking about with all this “Two months ago” crap?! You said all of that shit to me {i}yesterday!{/i} Stop trying to confuse me every chance you get!
lines.zh: : 还有，你嘴里那个「两个月前」到底是他妈什么鬼？！那些话你明明是{i}昨天{/i}才对我说的！你别一有机会就想搅乱我！

lines.en: : But if that’s what we talked about yesterday, what did we talk about at the end of the Dorm Wars?
lines.zh: : 可如果我们昨天聊的是那些，那 Dorm Wars 结束的时候我们又聊了什么？

lines.en: : The fuck are you on, dude? We-
lines.zh: : 你他妈在说什么啊，老兄？我们——

lines.en: scene beachmassanta36

lines.zh: : 我们……

lines.en: : That’s...
lines.zh: : 那是……

lines.en: : That’s...weird...
lines.zh: : 那是……不对劲……

lines.en: : I can’t really remember...
lines.zh: : 我真的想不起来了……

lines.en: scene beachmassanta37
: I remember...coming to the closing ceremony thing to talk to you about...
lines.zh: : 我记得……我来那个闭幕式之类的场合，是想跟你谈谈……

lines.en: scene beachmassanta38
: About...the same thing I’m talking about today? But why...would...
lines.zh: : 谈谈……跟今天一样的那件事？可为什么……会……

lines.en: : What the fuck?...
lines.zh: : 什么情况？……

lines.en: : What the {i}fuck?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么情况{/i}？

lines.en: : Do you remember...{i}anything{/i} from the last two months, Yumi?
lines.zh: : 你还记得……这两个月里的{i}任何事{/i}吗，Yumi？

lines.en: scene beachmassanta39
: Yeah, obviously! It wasn’t much different from how shit normally is. I woke up...went to sc-
lines.zh: : 当然记得了！跟平常没什么两样啊。我起床……去上——

lines.en: scene beachmassanta40
: Wait, no. I was suspended from school, wasn’t I? How’d I get back in? {i}When{/i} did I get back in? And why don’t I...
lines.zh: : 等等，不对。我不是被停学了吗？我怎么回的学校？{i}什么时候{/i}回的？还有我为什么……

lines.en: scene beachmassanta41
: What...the fuck is going on right now? Why can’t I remember anything?
lines.zh: : 现在到底……他妈是怎么回事？我为什么什么都想不起来？

lines.en: : Maybe you just...{i}skipped{/i} the last couple months?
lines.zh: : 也许你只是……{i}跳过{/i}了最近这两个月？

lines.en: : {i}Skipped{/i} them? Are you fucking crazy?
lines.zh: : {i}跳过{/i}了？你他妈疯了吗？

lines.en: : I know how it sounds. And there are probably rules against me telling you this, but that’s exactly how it happened for me.
lines.zh: : 我知道这话听起来很离谱。而且大概有规定不让我告诉你，但我的经历就是这样。

lines.en: : I started talking to you at the end of the Dorm Wars...blinked...and suddenly we were all here.
lines.zh: : 我在 Dorm Wars 结束时开始跟你说话……眨了下眼……然后我们就全都到这儿了。

lines.en: scene beachmassanta42
: This really isn’t the time to fuck with me, dick.
lines.zh: : 现在真不是耍我的时候，混蛋。

lines.en: : Seriously, what the {i}fuck?{/i}
lines.zh: : 说真的，到底{i}他妈{/i}怎么回事？

lines.en: My phone goes off while Yumi is busy staring into space (For reasons I completely understand) and I seize the opportunity to take a look at who it is.
lines.zh: Yumi 正忙着发呆的时候（原因我完全理解），我的手机响了，我趁机看了一眼是谁。

lines.en: : {i}Merry Christmas! I asked Chika where you were since I saw you guys leave together and she told me you were busy, but I wanted to remind you about our plans tonight.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}圣诞快乐！我看见你们俩一起走了，就问 Chika 你去哪儿了，她说你在忙，但我想提醒你一下我们今晚的计划。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You don’t HAVE to come if it’s something super serious and whatnot, but I’ll be in this little clearing thing I found near where the forest meets the dunes.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如果是什么特别严重的事，你不来也行，不过我会在森林和沙丘交界处附近我找到的那么一小块空地上。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You can get there from a trail about half a mile west of the inn, but it’s kind of hard to see when it’s dark, so I drew a big heart in the sand. Turn there and follow that until you find me. {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}从旅馆往西大概半英里的地方有条小路上去，但天黑了不太好找，所以我在沙子上画了个大大的爱心。到那儿拐弯，顺着它走就能找到我。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I started a bonfire for the two of us (Or just me if you can’t come) so that might help you find me as well.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我给咱们俩生了堆篝火（你要是不能来，就是我一个人的），也许也能帮你找到我。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Anyway, that’s all! Just checking in and letting you know I’m here whenever you want to (Or don’t want to) come.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}总之就这些！只是跟你说一声，你想来（或者不想来）的时候，我都在这儿。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}See you soon. Maybe <3{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}待会儿见。也许吧 <3{/i}

lines.en: : Yumi, I-

lines.zh: : 嗯，去吧。

lines.en: : But we ain’t done. We’ll pick this shit up once I can actually think again.
lines.zh: : 但这事没完。等我能重新思考了，我们接着说。

lines.en: : Well, best of luck. And let me know if you figure anything out because it would sure as hell be a huge help.
lines.zh: : 那祝你好运。你要是搞清楚了什么，记得告诉我，那绝对是帮了大忙。
